title: The Big White House - Pool! Facing Shelby Park
description:
Just 3 minutes from downtown, you will find a large white house with a wrap around porch awaiting your arrival. This brand new home faces the gorgeous Shelby Park & connects to Nashville's Greenway! Luxurious, private home in hip East Nashville! Heated in-ground Pool!

The space
Located in the artistic East Nashville neighborhood, this brand new home overlooks Shelby Park & a gorgeous view of downtown. With quick access to downtown, the Greenway bike trail, Shelby Park, and East Nashville's 5 Points, the location couldn't be better for anyone taking a trip to Nashville or passing through town! Heated in-ground Pool for your enjoyment! Open May-September (weather dependent). 

Our home is brand new and designed for the ultimate Airbnb experience. The space includes 4 bedrooms (1 King bed and 3 queen beds, 1 pull out bed), 2 queen air mattresses and a second pull out sofa. In total you can sleep 10 people comfortably! 

The home is walking distance to many restaurants, coffee shops, bars, and about a 15-20 minute walk to downtown. We encourage you to take advantage of the incredible park at your doorstep & explore the 900 acres of green space. Our front yard is the Frisbee Golf Course, so many guests take advantage of that. We are excited to meet you & we hope you enjoy the home as much as we do!

Guest access
Guests can park in the parking lot at the corner of S 17th St & Sevier St or on the street in front of the house. The front door code will be provided a week before your stay for keyless entry. Come on in and make yourself at home!

host_details:
Originally from Chicago & Indianapolis, we got married 9/20/14 and have enjoyed many trips together including Barcelona, Charleston SC, Aspen CO, Boulder CO, Asheville NC, Atlanta GA, Destin FL, and a few other incredible places. We have been blessed to stay with many great Airbnb hosts along the way and are excited  host our guest bedroom to other adventurers like ourselves. Josh used to be in a Christian Rock band is used to traveling and staying with strangers. Louise is Italian & hospitable at heart. We have a adorable dog named Forrest (like the Gump) and he will instantly love you, we're sure. We love meeting new people & enjoy riding our bikes to breakfast on Saturday mornings to our favorite breakfast spot in our neighborhood Sky Blue, and enjoy red wine & lots of coffee. Jessica likes rock climbing & Josh does too but he is better at Soccer. We live in a very artistic/historic part of East Nashville and absolutely love it. Hope to get to meet you on your adventure or ours!
